notes: The contrary-intention carve-out and the joint nature of the obligation are both kept; only the placement of the 'unless' clause is rearranged. No change in legal effect.
Hindi text retains विपरीत आशय and joint liability; surface reordering only.
Precondition that the promisor has not already undertaken to perform without application is dropped, together with the proper-place and usual-hours restrictions. Duty is left unqualified.
Identical loss of precondition and qualifiers in the Hindi version.
'may' is hardened to 'must', converting a liberty into a duty; the phrase 'or sanctions' is also omitted, narrowing the accepted modes.
Modal change from possibility to obligation plus loss of alternative modes.
The severability rule is inverted: instead of the lawful branch remaining enforceable, neither branch can be enforced. Core consequence is reversed.
Same inversion of the severability principle in Hindi.
Substitute agreement, rescission and alteration are all preserved as triggering events; only wording is tightened.
All three discharge modes retained without substantive alteration.
Rescission is allowed but the restitution obligation that accompanies it is completely omitted. Half of the statutory bargain is missing.
Rescission kept; लाभ प्रत्यर्पण duty dropped.
The limiting phrase 'reasonable compensation not exceeding' is removed. The section’s protective ceiling becomes an entitlement to the full stipulated amount.
Ceiling language omitted; effect is reversed.
The contractual opt-out is deleted. Parties can no longer agree to a different liability regime even though the statute expressly allows it.
Opt-out clause removed in Hindi as well.
'Invalid' is rewritten as 'voidable at the option of the creditor'. Both the consequence and the party who holds the election are fabricated; the party at fault is given the right.
Same fabricated consequence and wrong-party election in Hindi.
'Must' is softened to 'should' while the exception limb remains. Pure deontic weakening with no other loss.
Parallel modal softening in Hindi.
